title: Audit P104 helper histories with endpoint span constraints
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

A P104 history profile can pass the current crossing, endpoint-count and cost relaxations without enough endpoint geometry. This package proves two necessary histogram rows—total arrival dimension and departure codimension are each at least **832**—under the frozen X-only, monotone ZERO-to-FULL relay contract. A concrete 400-lifetime profile `329*(1,7,1) + 71*(1,1,1,1,1,1,1,1,1)` passes the earlier cut bounds (4873 each), reported lifetime-count floors and certified favorable cost bound (upper 0.999470826199440), but scores only **826** in both new rows.

A 406-lifetime control passes the new rows, so this is one profile exclusion and a reusable necessary screen, not a new universal lifetime floor or P104-route rejection. No construction, complete supplier invoice, frontier change or new exponent is claimed. Compatible frames, chronology, coefficients, physical owners, precision and the complete consumer remain open.

## Task and overlap

Task `supplier-boundary-audit`, scope key `dcdb0fa8e49b08a958d0`, priority revision 5. Scope is **changed** from the card's selected-supplier wording to the pending P104 supplier's explicitly prioritized endpoint/routing obligation. The selected binding baseline and card's historical owner-audit example passed as orientation controls.

Started from canonical main `ffbd90dd90dbe0055464f3a1411b25a3a4fdc6b8`; publication rebased onto refreshed main `38746ad3f6ffebcc0275e286b1dbb733d7c696dd`. Guidance, priority revision, selected record and all declared inputs were unchanged. Scientific pins remain at the starting main.

Nearest work: #2353 (rank-eight target support), #2614 (later-source reads), #2640 (seven crossing constraints), #2675 (coupled cost relaxation), #2682 (proper endpoint arrivals). Exact heads and authors are in `TASK.json`/`PROOF.md`. This supplies one geometry coupling requested by #2682, not a bug report against its correctly scoped relaxation.

The newer [Sagar Thakrar mixer handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-18960667), fork commit `743640530229e1821ae11dc104798871272d6f00`, already excludes the historical 208-lifetime example. This package credits that overlap and leads with the 400-lifetime profile, which passes its reported count floors. No independence from all structural facts in that handoff is asserted.

Final overlap covered all 486 open PRs, 2,097 closed/merged PRs and 1,543 Discussion records, refreshed 2026-10-16 07:36–07:37 UTC. Focused follow-up found own claim/package plus an unrelated endpoint-span note. Search omits code diffs/arbitrary nested files and is not proof of novelty. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-18966662).

## Validation

- CPython 3.12.13 registered replay: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-endpoint-span-audit` — PASS. Both commands use `-I -O -B` and explicit exceptions.
- CPython 3.14.4 direct optimized runs of both scripts — PASS.
- Independent binary-elimination checker reconstructs 104 rank-eight arrival spans and 104 rank-eight departure spans, 4,992 demands, 336 later-readable pairs, no direct bypass and all 256 positive-composition histories. It imports no primary/predecessor checker.
- Primary checker reuses authenticated PR2675 geometry and Douglas Colkitt's exact rational cost engine, executing their source bytes directly. Controls distinguish zero-weight visits, asymmetric endpoint rows, the rejected 400 profile and surviving 406 control.
- Metadata/source pins, exact committed bytes (17 files) and whitespace checks — PASS. Registered replay rerun after rebase.

The universal implication is in `PROOF.md`; finite checks do not prove all possible relay programs by enumeration. No selected cold replay, full native supplier replay, mixer-fork replay, new LP optimization, proof assistant or independent human review is claimed.

## Credit

Hiroki Kumazaki (kumagi), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for derivation, coding, separate-agent proof review and independent checker development. Agents share context; implementation independence is not independent human discovery. Apache-2.0.

Credit Philippe Van Velzen and kumagi/PR2353; ywz65/PR2614; Nick Petalas/PR2640 and PR2604; Arham Tahir/PR2675 and PR2682; Sagar Thakrar's mixer handoff; Rohan Arun, Chafik Boukhalfa, Adam Gall, Josie Elliston and Ali Romman for the frozen geometry/native lineage. Douglas Colkitt's ceiling engine retains its Claude assistance credit. No predecessor files changed or vendored.

## Open next questions

Before further construction, check whether compatible endpoint-frame assignments or chronology exclude the surviving 406 profile, incorporating stronger local facts from the mixer handoff. `TASK.json` and the package README give the bounded first step and remaining blockers. This contribution stops after the necessary-constraint audit.
